response.rationale: The item is an accessory (not electronics), not final sale, and delivered 6 days ago (within the 30-day standard window). RET-007 applies (days_since_delivery <= 30 and final_sale == False), making it eligible. No higher-priority rule applies: not final sale (RET-012), not defective (RET-020), no fraud hold (RET-051), and not electronics (RET-002/003).
